description_en: Queries the complete configuration of a specified scheduled vulnerability scanning policy
description_zh: 查询指定漏洞定时扫描策略的完整配置
name: GetVulScanScheduledStrategy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scheduled vulnerability scanning policy. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListVulScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVulScanScheduledStrategies~~): Queries scheduled vulnerability scanning policies.
[CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy~~): Creates a scheduled vulnerability scanning policy
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞定时扫描策略ID。取值来源：
[ListVulScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVulScanScheduledStrategies~~)：批量查询漏洞定时扫描策略。
[CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy~~)：创建漏洞定时扫描策略
parameters.name: strategy_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the policy was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 策略创建时间，秒级Unix时间戳

CustomMatchGroup.description_en: The effective scope specified by organizational structure. If no organizational structure is configured, an empty list is returned
CustomMatchGroup.description_zh: 按组织架构指定的生效范围。未按组织架构配置时返回空列表

items.description_en: The effective scope of the organizational structure

Group.description_en: The collection of organizational structure nodes

items.description_en: The distinguished name (DN) of the organizational structure node

IdpId.description_en: The ID of the identity source

LastTriggerTime.description_en: The time when the policy last triggered a scan. The value is a UNIX timestamp accurate to seconds. If the policy has never been triggered, 0 is returned
LastTriggerTime.description_zh: 策略最近一次触发扫描的时间，秒级Unix时间戳。从未触发过时返回0

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching mode for the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Applies only to users in the specified user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效

MatchTargetIds.description_en: The collection of effective user group IDs. If MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll, an empty list is returned
MatchTargetIds.description_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupAll时返回空列表

items.description_en: The ID of the user group

Priority.description_en: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100
Priority.description_zh: 策略优先级，数值越小优先级越高。取值范围：1~100

ScanBeginTime.description_en: The start hour when a scan is allowed to be triggered. The value must be an integer on the hour. Valid values: 0 to 23. The specified hour is included. This field is not a timestamp
ScanBeginTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的起始小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：0~23，包含该小时。本字段不是时间戳

ScanEndTime.description_en: The end hour when a scan is allowed to be triggered. The value must be an integer on the hour. Valid values: 1 to 24. The specified hour is excluded and must be greater than the value of ScanBeginTime. This field is not a timestamp
ScanEndTime.description_zh: 允许触发扫描的结束小时，取整点小时数，取值范围：1~24，不包含该小时，且必须大于ScanBeginTime。本字段不是时间戳

ScanFrequency.description_en:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
day: Day.
week: Week
ScanFrequency.description_zh:
触发周期的单位。取值：
day：按天。
week：按周

ScanInterval.description_en: The interval of the trigger cycle. This parameter and ScanFrequency determine the trigger cycle. Valid values: 1 to 30. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, a scan is performed once a week
ScanInterval.description_zh: 触发周期的间隔数，与ScanFrequency共同决定触发周期。取值范围：1~30。例如ScanFrequency取值为week、ScanInterval取值为1时，表示每周扫描一次

Status.description_en:
The enabling status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用

StrategyDescription.example: 每周日凌晨对研发部门终端执行漏洞扫描

StrategyId.description_en: The ID of the scheduled vulnerability scanning policy

StrategyName.example: 研发部门每周漏洞扫描

Whitelist.description_en: The whitelist of users. Scans based on this policy are not performed on the users in the whitelist. If no whitelist is configured, an empty list is returned
Whitelist.description_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行该策略的扫描。未配置时返回空列表
